name: Gearmo

bat._why: Hammer Bro's hammer at 0.635x about the grip; x1.26 with him = 0.80x the stock hammer (Nick: his hammer was too big at 0.55; kept about 0.8x after the size pass): python scripts/make_bat.py models/work/bats/gearmo-hammer.bin 45 --scale 0.635

_why_scale: Size pass 2 (Nick: the model fills its template skeleton like the template's own; scale is only how much bigger or smaller than the template, since it also sets the strike zone): 0.90x Mario's in-game height (model height x the Red Shy Guy sizescale row x scale; Mario = 1.0). Was 2.08: his model now fills Shy Guy's skeleton like Shy Guy's own (1.47 tall; it was 0.89, 64%, so 2.08 put his strike zone 1.6x too high).
_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick): own stats; chemistry starts neutral (not the template's). Galaxy 2 robots who help the Toad Brigade; crew on Starship Mario.
